name: Wikipedia Human Style Writing
description: Rewrite or draft prose so it avoids the tell-tale signs of AI writing, using Wikipedia's 'Signs of AI writing' field guide.
author: Chris Garty
coverImageAlt: A compact editorial press turns uniform blank paper stock into varied cyan-edged ribbons with a more natural rhythm.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: a rigid stack of mechanically identical blank paper ribbons passes through a warm editorial press and emerges as varied, naturally paced strips with distinct lengths and tactile character
Scene/backdrop: minimal warm-paper editor's table against a deep slate field with calm negative space
Subject: one compact press, uniform navy input ribbons, varied cyan-edged output ribbons, and one sparing orange adjustment wheel
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe focal subject centered; no essential detail in the outer 8%; transformation clear at card size
Lighting/mood: human, discerning, calm, quietly technical
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: every paper surface must be blank; no text, letters, numbers, punctuation, pseudo-writing, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI or Microsoft Fluent branding
Correction: scale down the press and both input and output ribbons so every paper form sits completely inside the inner 84% of the frame, remove the loose side paper stacks, and preserve generous clean negative space
